cases.question: How will the air be tonight?
cases.answer:

Live track record shows an overall MAE of 9.0 over 5,799 points, beating CAMS in 79 of 82 days.

cases.question: How sure is the forecast for 48 hours from now?
cases.answer: For the 25–48 hour lead time, the live track record shows an MAE of 9.26 and a skill vs CAMS of 50.1%. In backtesting at 48 hours, the MAE is 6.383 with an 80% range coverage of 80.3% (skill vs CAMS 39.2%).

cases.question: How accurate has this forecast actually been?
cases.answer: Our live track record shows an overall MAE of 9.0, beating CAMS on 79 of 82 days with a 50.7% skill score, while the 80% uncertainty range achieved 74.4% coverage. In rolling-origin backtests, the model achieved a mean skill of 48.6% versus CAMS and 20.7% versus persistence, with 80% range coverage hovering around 80% across lead times.

cases.question: Is this better than the Copernicus CAMS forecast?
cases.answer: Yes, this system outperforms the Copernicus CAMS forecast overall, beating it in 79 of 82 days with an overall skill score of 50.7% against CAMS (overall MAE of 9.0 against CAMS's 18.3).

cases.question: What is the backtested error at 72 hours?
cases.answer: At 72 hours, the backtested Mean Absolute Error (MAE) is 6.663. The 80% range coverage at this lead time is 80.9%, with a skill score of 36.5% vs CAMS and 19.8% vs persistence.

cases.question: How good is the 1-hour forecast?
cases.answer: For the 1-6 hour live track record bucket, the forecast has achieved an MAE of 6.4, beating CAMS (skill 0.685) and persistence (skill 0.275). In the rolling-origin backtest, the 1-hour lead time has an MAE of 2.798, an R2 of 0.941, and an 80% range coverage of 82.6%.

cases.question: What drives the forecast the most?
cases.answer: The 24-hour forecast is driven most by measured minus CAMS (now) with a mean SHAP value of 6.94, followed by the CAMS forecast for the target hour (3.86) and forecast wind speed (3.17). Other key factors include the measured PM2.5 3h mean (2.61), CAMS PM10 (1.49), and forecast temperature (1.46).

cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though CAMS has errors, the model uses it as a helpful input because it captures broad regional pollution transport and weather patterns. Our backtest accuracy shows that the system successfully corrects CAMS, achieving a mean skill vs CAMS of 48.6% across lead times.

cases.question: Is the data up to date?
cases.answer: Yes, the data is up to date, with the forecast issued from 2026-11-23 23:00:00 and the model generated at 2026-11-24T09:19:26.229417+00:00. The last retrain passed its accuracy gate, although there is major input drift with drifted inputs including temperature and degraded inputs including weather and CAMS.

cases.question: Did the latest model pass its checks?
cases.answer: Yes, the latest model passed its accuracy gate (`pass`), even though there is major input drift overall and the weather and CAMS inputs are degraded, with temperature specifically having drifted.

cases.question: Are conditions unusual compared with what the model was trained on?
cases.answer: Conditions are showing major input drift, with temperature specifically having drifted from training data, and weather and CAMS inputs currently degraded. Despite this, the last retrain passed its accuracy gate.

cases.answer:

Is waqt 80% range (p10 to p90) ke mutabiq PM2.5 89.15 aur 169.45 ke beech rehne ki tawaqqa hai. 

Live track record ke mutabiq is forecast ka overall MAE 9.007 hai aur yeh 79 of 82 dinon mein CAMS se behtar perform kar chuka hai.

cases.question: Ye forecast kitna sahi hota hai?
cases.answer: Live track record ke mutabiq, hamara forecast CAMS se behtar perform karta hai aur 79 of 82 days CAMS ko beat kiya hai, jiska overall MAE 9.007 hai aur 80% range coverage 74.4% hai. Backtest accuracy mein bhi mean skill vs CAMS 0.486 hai.

cases.answer: اگلے 72 گھنٹوں (آئندہ تین دنوں) کی پیشگوئی کے مطابق، آلودگی کا سب سے اونچا نقطہ (peak) کب ہوگا، اس کی تفصیل فی الحال سسٹم میں تکنیکی خرابی کی وجہ سے دستیاب نہیں ہے۔ براہ کرم کچھ دیر بعد دوبارہ کوشش کریں۔
